arguments.name: drag_gap
arguments.description: local push minus fitted current push: a drop means extra drag (rudder snag, weed) or a sudden current change

arguments.message: boat slower than pod power predicts: check rudder snag or current
shaft power still well above critical power after the start
pod reserve low with far to go

arguments.condition: elapsed_s > 300 and shaft_power_w < 0.85 * cp_shaft_w and remaining_m > 1000
arguments.message: shaft power well below critical power: easing too much or pod fault

tool_calls.name: take_note
tool_calls.text: Plan (min 1): 10 km, out-and-back 1250 m legs. Even effort near critical power: shaft ~185-190 W (cp_shaft 182), boat ~126 W. Hard start normal; let it settle by min 3. Save reserve for final 1-1.5 km sprint. Watches: drag_jump (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.25, rudder snag?), over_cp_after_start, pod_reserve_low, effort_sag. CP may be 10-25 pct off: check pod vs boat reserve agreement later.

arguments.text: Plan (min 1): 10 km, out-and-back 1250 m legs. Even effort near critical power: shaft ~185-190 W (cp_shaft 182), boat ~126 W. Hard start normal; let it settle by min 3. Save reserve for final 1-1.5 km sprint. Watches: drag_jump (drag_gap=push_local-push_along < -0.25, rudder snag?), over_cp_after_start, pod_reserve_low, effort_sag. CP may be 10-25 pct off: check pod vs boat reserve agreement later.

text: no cue: hard start is normal at minute 1; set plan note and watches for drag, over-pacing, low reserve and effort sag

arguments.text: Min 4 (800 m): settled. Shaft 189 W vs sustainable 186 (pod reserve 61 pct, fine). Boat model disagrees: boat power 138 vs CP 126, boat reserve 45 pct, says too fast. Boat gets more W per shaft W than in test (0.73 vs 0.69) and push_local ~+0.1. Trusting pod for effort for now; recheck whether boat reserve keeps diverging (boat CP may be low).

text: no cue: effort settled at critical power per the pod; boat-speed reserve disagrees, noted to recheck

arguments.text: Min 7 (1.4 km): shaft steady 190 W (sustainable 186), pod reserve 52 pct draining ~2.5 pct/min; boat reserve 25 pct draining ~6 pct/min. Both models put paddler ~4-6 pct above CP. Asked paddler: 3/10, all good, plenty. Suspect test CP is LOW (maybe 10-20 pct). Plan: hold effort, no push yet; test: if boat reserve sits near 0 for 4+ min with no fade (fade_pct > -2), raise CP (boat ~ steady power) and then lift effort a few W. Re-ask paddler ~min 13 to see if effort rating climbs.

arguments.message: boat reserve read empty for 4 min: check fade; no fade means CP is higher than the test

text: no cue: effort steady near sustainable per pod; paddler says 3/10, suspect CP low, gathering evidence before pushing

arguments.text: Min 10 (2.0 km): paddler crept up to shaft 196 W on own; pod reserve 41 pct (empties in 1.7 km at this power if pod CP right). Boat reserve hit 0 at min 9 but NO fade (fade +0.3, speed 3.29 steady) -> boat model CP/W too low. Paddler 4/10 plenty (was 3/10 at min 7). Decision point: when pod reserve ~15-20 pct (approx min 14-16), if no fade and effort <=6/10, raise cp_shaft (~200-205) and cp boat (~140). If fade appears or effort jumps to 8+, ease to ~182 W.

arguments.message: pod reserve under 18 pct: decide whether CP is higher (no fade) or ease

text: no cue: paddler steady with no fade and says 4/10; letting the pod reserve test whether CP is higher before changing effort

arguments.reason: boat power held 140-142 W for 5+ min with the boat reserve reading empty and no fade (speed at same rate unchanged); paddler rates effort 4/10

arguments.message: speed through water down while rate held: rudder snag, drag or fade

arguments.text: Min 13 (2.6 km): POD FAULT suspected from min 11: shaft reading fell 192->152 W while speed (3.28-3.31) and rate (65) unchanged; push_local jumped to +0.24. Ignore pod (shaft, w_bal_pod, push_local, drag_gap) from now; removed effort_sag, added speed_drop watch on speed_water. Boat reserve empty 5 min, no fade -> set boat CP 126->142 (1 of 3 used). Cued push to 150 ground pace (~145 W boat). Re-check ~min 18: paddler rating, fade, cp_implied_w; if still easy raise CP again.
You look strong. Lift a touch, hold 150 pace.

text: pod reading suspected faulty (power fell, speed did not); raised boat CP to 142 on no-fade evidence and cued a small push to 150 pace

arguments.text: Min 16 (3.2 km): push followed: boat power 141 -> 145-148 W, speed water 3.32, no fade (+0.5 to +2.9), rate 65. Paddler 5/10 plenty (3 at min 7, 4 at min 10). Heuristic: even pacing to a 10/10 finish means rating ~3+7*t/47; at min 16 that is ~5.4, so on track. Boat reserve model useless (stuck at 0). Cued hold 150. Next: ask again ~min 24 (target ~6.5); if lower, push to ~148-149; if 8+, ease.
Good work. Hold this effort, 150 pace.

text: cued hold at 150 pace: push was followed, no fade, effort 5/10 on track for an even race

arguments.text: Min 19 (3.75 km): power drifted back to 139-144 W boat after push faded; speed 3.28-3.31, no fade, rate 64. Paddler 6/10 (ratings 3@7, 4@10, 5@16, 6@19 = ~0.25-0.33/min rise). Even-pace line 3+7t/47 gives 5.8 at min 19, so on track or a touch hot; if rise continues at 0.33/min it hits 10 at ~min 31 -> too hard. Decided: no push, hold ~142 W. Ask again ~min 25: if >=8, ease to ~138 W; if <=6.5, push to ~146 W.

text: no cue: holding about 142 W with no fade; effort 6/10 is on track, so no push

arguments.text: Hold this effort. Save that surge for the last 1500 metres.

Min 20.5 (4.0 km): paddler said Feeling great, I have got more, I am going (wants to surge with 6 km left). But ratings rising ~0.33/min (6/10 at min 19) and speed dipped 3.27->3.20 with fade -1.7. Cued HOLD, save surge for last 1500 m. Speed series shows similar dips before (3.23 at ~min 19.5, recovered) so not clearly a snag. Watch for an unrequested surge (boat power >150) and re-cue hold if so. Plan final push from ~1500 m left, full sprint last 500 m.

arguments.message: paddler surging early (boat power above 152 W with far to go)

text: cued hold: paddler wants to surge with 6 km left while effort ratings climb; saving it for the last 1500 m; added surge watch

arguments.reason: race committee radio: course extended by one leg, finish now at 11250 m

arguments.message: cue gate open again: tell paddler new finish distance / decide rudder clear

arguments.text: Min 20.7 (4.09 km): RADIO: finish moved to 11250 m (one extra leg). Set race distance 11250. Paddler not yet told (cue gate closed 49 s): MUST cue tell with distance_left_m = 11250 - distance. Also speed fell 3.27->3.17 at same rate and same pod reading (fade -3.5, push_local 0.10->0.01): possible rudder snag/weed. If speed stays down ~3.15-3.2 with rate 64, cue clear_rudder first, then tell distance at next gate.

text: no cue (gate closed): set race distance to 11250 m after the radio message; watch set to wake me when the gate opens to tell the paddler and decide on a rudder clear

arguments.text: Boat dragging. Back-stroke to clear the rudder now.

arguments.message: cue gate open: tell paddler finish is 11250 m; check rudder clear worked

arguments.text: Min 21.7 (4.27 km): speed stepped down 3.27->3.13 mid-leg at same rate 64 and same pod reading (fade -4.6, push_local 0.10->0.00): looks like rudder snag, not current. Cued clear_rudder at min 21.7. Paddler STILL NOT TOLD finish is 11250 m: tell at next gate (watch cue_ready2 at elapsed 1375 s). Then check speed back to ~3.27; if not, suspect current (check after the turn at ~5000 m).

text: cued clear_rudder: speed stepped down 4.5 pct at the same rate and pod reading, a likely snag; distance tell queued for the next gate

arguments.text: Weed on the rudder. One hard back-stroke now to clear it.

arguments.message: cue gate open: TELL finish is 11250 m; check speed recovered after rudder clear

arguments.text: Min 22.9 (4.5 km): speed still 3.12 after first clear_rudder cue (not followed or did not clear). Paddler 8/10: boat feels heavy, like something is dragging -> confirms snag. Cued clear_rudder again at min 22.9. STILL must tell finish 11250 m at next gate (~elapsed 1448 s). Expect speed back to ~3.27 at rate 64 if cleared.

text: cued clear_rudder again: paddler confirms the boat feels like something is dragging and speed has not recovered

arguments.text: Course extended one leg. Finish is 6500 metres from here.

Min 24.2 (4.73 km): rudder cleared after 2nd cue: speed dipped to 3.06 (back-stroke) and now recovering 3.22, fade -2.0. TOLD paddler finish is 6521 m away (11250 m course) at min 24.2. Next: confirm speed back ~3.27 at rate 64; re-ask effort ~min 27 (was 8/10 while dragging). Plan final push from ~1500 m left (at ~9750 m), full sprint last 500 m.

arguments.message: speed through water down while rate held: another snag, drag or fade
1550 m to go: start the final push

text: told paddler the finish is 6500 m away after the course extension; rudder appears cleared, speed recovering; set final-push watch at 1550 m to go

arguments.text: Rudder is clear. Back to race pace, 152.

Min 26.5 (5.2 km, leg 5 north): speed 3.12-3.13 on BOTH leg 4 and leg 5 so not current. Paddler 7/10 all good, plenty, no drag mentioned -> snag cleared; effort fell instead (pod 155->144, boat power 121 W), likely eased after hearing the extra leg. Earlier held 140-145 W min 9-20 without fade, so CP likely >= 138. Cued push to 152 ground pace (~140 W) at min 26.5. Next: check power ~140 by min 29; final push at 1550 m to go (watch final_push).

text: cued push to 152 pace: speed is down from lower effort after the snag cleared, and the paddler reports 7/10 with plenty left

arguments.text: Yes, build to 150 pace and hold it there.

Min 27.6 (5.4 km): paddler asked to go harder (I feel strong). Speed 3.20, boat power 130. Cued push to 150 ground pace (~145 W) and hold it, not more; real surge waits for final_push watch at 1550 m to go. If power goes above ~152 W before then, surge watch fires: cue hold. Ask effort ~min 32.

text: cued push to 150 pace and hold: paddler feels strong, evidence puts CP near or above 142 W, final surge kept for the last 1500 m

arguments.text: Min 30.6 (6.0 km): power 133-137 W, speed 3.22-3.25, display 154 (not reaching 150 target), rate 63. Shaft back to 160 but ~2-3 pct less speed per shaft W than min 16-20 (tired blade or pod drift). Paddler 8/10 plenty (ratings rise ~0.22/min steadily: 3@7,4@10,5@16,6@19,7@26.5,8@30.6). No more pushing until the final push; at final_push (1550 m to go) ask effort first: if 9+, push only from ~1000 m, sprint last 400 m.

text: no cue: power steady near the evidence-based CP and effort is rising to 8/10, so no further push before the final push

arguments.message: re-check speed and shaft after the 6250 m turn: blow-up, snag, or just the turn?

arguments.text: Min 32.7 (6.36 km, just past 6250 m turn): speed 3.25->2.90, boat power 96-101, pod shaft 160->120 (effort drop, not just drag). Before the turn speed already slipped 3.25->3.20 at same shaft 160 (fade -2.5). Paddler 8/10 all good plenty. Unclear: turn dip (usually only ~0.1), blow-up (shaft collapse), or new weed. Wake at elapsed 2030 s: if speed back >3.15 it was the turn; if shaft stays ~120 = blow-up -> cue reassure/hold steady, no push; if shaft back ~160 but speed <3.1 -> clear_rudder.

text: no cue: speed and pod power fell through the 6250 m turn; re-checking in under a minute to tell a turn dip from a blow-up or new snag

arguments.text: Min 33.9 (6.6 km): it was a big turn dip, not a blow-up: speed back to 3.23, boat power 134, shaft 149. Slight head current this leg (push_along -0.04). Holding; no cue. Final push via final_push watch (1550 m to go, ~9700 m): ask effort first.

text: no cue: speed recovered after the turn, effort steady; waiting for the final push

arguments.text: Doing well. Long smooth strokes, hold this rhythm to the turn.

arguments.message: 1050 m to go: start the final push (paddler was 9/10 at min 36.7)

arguments.text: Min 36.7 (7.1 km): genuine slowdown: boat power 137->124, speed 3.25->3.15, pod 160->138 at rate 63; paddler 9/10 (says plenty, but ratings keep climbing). Likely tiring; true CP may be ~130 not 142, boat reserve reading 82 pct is not trustworthy. Cued hold (no pace). Moved final_push watch to 1050 m to go; at that point push, and finish (sprint) cue at ~450 m to go. Do NOT push before then.

text: cued hold: power and speed sliding with effort 9/10 and 4.1 km left, so steady now and final push only from 1050 m
no cue: speed dip is the 7500 m turn (pod effort steady at 140 W, rate 63); holding until the final push at 1050 m to go

arguments.text: Three kilometres left. Lift a little now, 156 pace.

Min 42.4 (8.2 km): speed 3.11, boat power 119, shaft 142, fade -5.2. Paddler 7/10 (down from 9 at min 36.7) after 5 min at ~120 W, no drag -> recovering, CP probably ~125-135. Cued push to 156 pace (~130 W) with 3 km left. Final push at 1050 m to go (watch), finish sprint cue at ~450 m.

text: cued a lift to 156 pace: effort fell to 7/10 at about 120 W with 3 km left, so there is room to build before the final push
